description: Inspect the leaf certificate a host serves on a live TLS handshake: subject, issuer, subject-alternative names, validity window and days to expiry, key and signature algorithms, serial, thumbprint, the negotiated TLS protocol/cipher, and the chain with its trust verdict. Complements cert_transparency (historical CT logs) with the certificate presented right now. Makes a benign TLS handshake to the target (no HTTP request); guarded against internal targets.

host.description: Host name or IP, e.g. example.com

name: tls_certificate
